facts.material: paper (48 colored strips with pre-cut notches)
facts.function: party decoration (paper chain garland about 13 ft when assembled)
facts.form: flat-packed strips in polybag with header card, assembled by purchaser without glue or fasteners

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9505 festive, carnival or other entertainment articles; chapter 48 note 2 excludes articles of chapter 95, so paper is not classified in 4823
GRI 2(a): unassembled strips with pre-cut notches have the essential character of the finished garland
GRI 6: 9505.90 other; 9505.90.40 confetti, paper spirals or streamers, party favors and noisemakers (flimsy, disposable paper party decorations), statistical suffix .00

rejected_alternatives.reason: 'Other' festive articles; CBP places flimsy single-use paper party decorations in 9505.90.40
articles of paper; chapter 48 excludes articles of chapter 95

classification.rationale: The paper chain garland is a festive decoration of heading 9505, and chapter 48 excludes chapter 95 articles. CBP treats flimsy, disposable paper party decorations as party favors in 9505.90.40, as in NY N331026 (paper pop-up centerpiece, flimsy, one-time use), and in earlier rulings on paper garlands. The unassembled notched strips are classified as the finished garland under GRI 2(a).
